title: CreateTaskRequest
description: Exactly one of: thread (create a thread, its root and the task; L1) or thread_id (convert an existing thread; L2).

thread.description: The thread (and root message) created with the task. The root text becomes brief revision 1.

text.description: Markdown; at most limits.max_text_bytes bytes of UTF-8. Copied as brief revision 1 (TASK-014).

labels.description: Label keys are case-insensitive on input and normalized to lowercase; the 'yak.' prefix is reserved.

assignee_actor_id.description: Optional assignee: the only eligible claimant. Must be an actor that can read the task channel, else 400 validation_failed (TASK-051).

depends_on.description: Prerequisite task IDs on the same board. Duplicates are de-duplicated. At most limits.max_dependencies_per_task (413). Unknown, cross-board or unreadable is 404 not_found with task_id.

direct_action_required.description: Human gate marker (DLG-090). Default false. Only a manager with a direct credential may set or clear it.

depends_on_asks.description: P3 proposed yak.asks: readable same-board ask prerequisites, separate from task IDs (ASK-011).
